title: Concept: SHA-1 use via Insecure.SHA1.hash (swift) — review required
description: In swift, Insecure.SHA1.hash computes SHA-1. Public collision demonstrations ended SHA-1's suitability for signatures and integrity, though content addressing and legacy interop remain legitimate. The swift-specific remedy is SHA256.hash.
applicability: swift codebases hashing data through Insecure.SHA1.hash; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Forged signatures and integrity values where SHA-1 guards trust; LOW default severity, raised when the digest is security-relevant.
